The end card is in `./s5/`: a 3-second, 1920×1080 composition that reveals "github.com/mohessaid/girth" in the same style as `s1`. `npx hyperframes check --json` reports no errors. It does leave two warnings, explained below.

**Animation:**
- A short gold rule draws in under the text starting at 0.2s.
- The URL then wipes in left to right with a slight rise, from 0.6s to 1.5s.
- It holds until 3s.
- At 0s the first few letters are already visible, because a blank first frame had triggered a `first_frame_empty` warning.

**Look:** Playfair Display on the dark `#0f1115` background, with the same cream and gold colours as `s1`.

**Editing:** The URL is a variable (`data-var-text`, default `github.com/mohessaid/girth`), so it can be changed in the HyperFrames desktop app.

**Remaining warnings:** Both are `nested_structure_needs_subcomposition`, because the text and rule sit inside clip wrappers. `s1` is built the same way. I left them because the scene is a single card.

I looked at the snapshot at 2s and the final layout is clean. I didn't open the 0.5s frame or render an MP4, and the existing `s1` is untouched.
